# Citing

A plain heading citation: `src/target.md#Naming`.
A heading ending in a parenthetical: `src/target.md#Adding a dependency (the gate)`.
A markdown link target: [the model](src/target.md#the-layered-gating-model) in prose.
A bare heading reference in prose: src/target.md#Adding a dependency (the gate), then more text.
A section reference: `src/target.md § Parallel mode - Phase 1: concurrent stage dispatch`.
A section holding a parenthetical: `src/target.md § Check if a PR exists (re-run safety)`.
A heading holding double quotes: `src/target.md#6.9 Surface in the final summary "Your move" section`.
